messages:
pagerbot: SEV-2 alert — prefix cache hit-rate drop on kv-cache-prod (us-west-2). metric: prefix_hit_pct < 30% for 5m. paging oncall @oncall-alex :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: on it. standing up thread. quick ask — any deploys in last 10m? @deploy-bot what changed? :eyes:

deploy-bot: rollback/deploy events: none in last 15m. last successful deploy: 1766999800 (service: cache-invalidator)

meera: seeing client-side retries spike too. customer reports increased latency and 502s for embed requests. lia-cs, any customers impacted flagged?

lia-cs: two self-serve customers flagged via support form (acct-redwood-smb, acct-finbox). reported higher latencies since ~21:02 UTC. submitting impact notes to incident page.

jordan: Grafana: prefix hit-rate across primary kv pool dropped from ~78% -> 18% starting 21:01 UTC. eviction_rate metric spiked at same time. link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/kv/prefix-hit-rate?from=now-30m :link:

sam: digging into logs. query to compute per-prefix hitrate:```promql
sum by(prefix) (increase(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by(prefix) (increase(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))
```

sam: top noisy prefixes show very low reuse — many single-use prefixes. suspect invalidation storm or ttl misconfiguration after a control-plane change.

meera: hypothesis list — 1) invalidation policy switched to aggressive wildcard purge; 2) ttl lowered accidentally (30s -> 1s); 3) rewarm workers saturated (warmup queue backlog); 4) client behavior change causing more unique prefixes.

oncall-alex: immediate mitigations we can try: A) temporarily disable wildcard invalidation; B) bump default prefix TTL to 300s; C) scale warmup workers by +3; D) enable sticky routing to older pool. Which are low-risk?

jordan: A and B are our fastest. A requires feature-flag flip (cache-invalidator:invalidate_wildcard=false). B is config push to kv-config service. doing A first.

meera: I will run queries to find the earliest timestamp of invalidation events.```json
{"query":"increase(kv_cache_invalidation_events_total{type=\"wildcard\"}[10m])"}
```result: spike at 21:00:45 UTC (~1767000045) matching hitdrop start.

sam: running warmup queue status:```
# redis queue length
LRANGE warmup-queue 0 10
# result: many pending items, workers: 2/5 busy, avg processing latency 750ms
```

lia-cs: customer impact summary posted to incident page: 2x SMB customers with degraded latency, no data loss. CS notified clients and set expectations.

oncall-alex: Applying mitigation A now — flipping flag. @jordan and @sam monitor.

jordan: `kubectl set env deploy/cache-invalidator INVALIDATE_WILDCARD=false --namespace=prod` — applied in us-west-2. watching metrics.

sam: eviction_rate decreasing within 60s, prefix_hit_pct climbing: 18% -> 35% at 21:05 UTC. :thumbsup:

meera: while A looks good, we should also bump TTL to avoid another flare. planning B now — will push kv-config default_ttl_s=300 with a canary to 10% traffic.

oncall-alex: canary + rollouts: use ramp 10% -> 50% over 10m. set alerts for tokenized endpoints.

jordan: started canary — config pushed to 2 nodes (10% traffic). monitoring warmup queue and hitrate.

sam: warmup queue drain rate improved after A — backlog decreasing, worker CPU trending down. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/kv/warmup-queue

lia-cs: customers confirmed partial recovery; one asks for RC explanation and ETA for full recovery. sending that we expect stabilization in 15-20m.

meera: collecting logs for RCA. saving sample invalidation events and related traces:```text
[21:00:45] invalidation: wildcard purge triggered by job:cache-maintenance:id=42
[21:00:46] eviction: prefix=usr:embedding:client-xyz evicted, reason=ttl_zero
[21:01:12] request: prefix=usr:embedding:client-xyz miss, downstream latency=120ms
```

sam: note — there was a config rollout earlier today that changed the invalidation window for scheduled maintenance from 1h -> 5m, that combined with a cron jitter seems to have concentrated the purge. recording as contributing factor.

oncall-alex: action items (tracked here): 1) jordan — post config diff to the ops-runbook + revert schedule change (in config repo) (ETA 40m). 2) sam — collect top-100 prefixes that were evicted and link to customers (ETA 25m). 3) meera — draft initial RCA hypothesis and timeline (ETA 60m). 4) lia-cs — update affected customers and request postmortem distribution list.

jordan: rolling back the maintenance window change in config repo now. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/configs/pull/789 :white_check_mark:

sam: uploading logs bundle to shared bucket: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1767001234/cache-warmup-bundle.tar.gz

meera: compiling timeline so far: - 20:59:50 UTC: scheduled maintenance window config change rollout finished - 21:00:45 UTC: wildcard invalidation spike observed - 21:01:00 UTC: prefix-hit-rate drop starts - 21:03:00 UTC: mitigation A applied (disable wildcard invalidation) - 21:06:00 UTC: observable hit-rate recovery begins - 21:20:00 UTC: canary TTL bump rolling, warmup continues

lia-cs: CS ticket numbers: #INC-1412, #INC-1413. adding customers and notes.

oncall-alex: closing pager escalation for now — metrics stable but keep thread open for RCA and postmortem. if anything regresses ping @oncall-alex immediately. :locked:

meera: final note for thread: primary root cause candidate — combined config change (maintenance window jitter) + wildcard invalidation behavior causing concentrated purge -> eviction storm -> cache miss cascade. plan: revert maintenance window change, add rate-limiter on wildcard invalidation, improve warmup autoscaling, and add a canary/guard for maintenance rollouts. I'll draft the RCA doc in /incidents/rcas and link back.

jordan: logging postmortem skeleton in #postmortems and assigning owners.

sam: leaving final logs and hit-rate plots in the incident artifact folder. marking mitigation as successful. :white_check_mark:

lia-cs: sending recovery note to affected customers now.

deploy-bot: summary: no deploy rollback required; config tweak reverted.

oncall-alex: thanks team — good coordination. closing live mitigation. will follow up on RCA doc and next steps.
